candidates.term: The Artisan inside the Year Gate
candidates.defline: The Artisan lives inside your Year Gate: the root of your early world was nourishment, given and remembered.
candidates.reading: This position rules Family and Health, and it works from the root of your story. The Artisan lives inside your Year Gate, the hidden face: nourishment was built into your early world, as food, ease, or someone’s quiet generosity, and your body still remembers it. You restore quickly, you digest life well, and comfort works on you as medicine rather than indulgence. Blessing in your line flows downhill through the older generation, often by way of the kitchen. Health stays your quiet inheritance so long as you keep the habits that honor it. Feed people in your turn. Your luck has always traveled with the table, and it still does.
candidates.teaser: Somewhere early, someone fed you well, in every sense. That ease still lives underneath you, and providing for others will keep quietly providing for you.

domain_readings.Family: Your family root carries sweetness: somewhere in the early line, nurture was generous, and it still reaches you as an instinct for kinship and comfort. You gather relatives the way hearths gather chairs. Keep the recipes and the rituals. They are the family’s actual inheritance, and you are their keeper.
domain_readings.Health: Your constitution is fundamentally friendly: good digestion of food and of life, recovery that arrives with rest and a proper meal. The risks are indulgence-shaped rather than fragility-shaped. Keep pleasure rhythmic, feast and fast in gentle alternation, and this body will carry you further than most.

candidates.life_chapter: The early chapter fed you: comfort somewhere in the first years that your nervous system still trusts. Even if the house was imperfect, something nourishing got through, and you have drawn on that deposit in every lean season since.
candidates.relations: Grandparents and the older kitchen line are this seat’s people: blessing descends to you through whoever fed the family. Keep their recipes and their names alive. The care you inherited wants passing on, and it multiplies when you host.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the seat asks for appetite: eat well, rest properly, accept comfort. Your luck refills through the body first.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, ease becomes indulgence here: comfort eaten past nourishment. Keep the feasts, add the fasts.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, this root drifts: sweetness used as sedative, the couch quietly winning years.
candidates.health_line: Your constitution runs on comfort honestly taken: regular meals, real rest, pleasure without guilt. Feed it on schedule and it forgives almost everything else.
